name: Hot Badger 62
author: lenfear23
description: Outlined pill gray checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes -10px -10px 15px #ffffff,
  10px 10px 15px #464646,
  inset -10px -10px 15px #ffffff,
  inset 10px 10px 15px #464646, border becomes solid #15e38a, transform becomes rotate(45deg).
